trigger: The contrastive task prompt intentionally contains both left and right, while the original scorer helper required exactly one direction token.
change: For closed-loop episodes only, obtain the requested relation from the authoritative matched task-directory identity (LeftOfBowl or RightOfBowl), which is also the source of the simulator success predicate. Do not parse negation or direction scope from policy text inside the visual scorer.
unchanged: all localization prompts and model weights
all calibration values and semantic thresholds
future frame indices and conditioning-frame exclusion
fixed-observation probe request parser for applicable single-direction conditions
outcome_timing_disclosure: Two declarative-left Cosmos episodes had completed and both succeeded. No contrastive episode and no declarative/contrastive semantic localization or label existed.
validity_reason: The visual scorer should evaluate generated content against the registered task target, not become an unregistered language model for resolving a deliberately difficult contrastive prompt.
claim_boundary: This amendment does not decide whether the policy understood negation. The policy sees the full prompt; the scorer merely compares generated/executed relations with the task predicate.
